message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar chart comparing mean task reward for three skill conditions across eight domains and the overall average.","description":"The chart plots mean task reward (%) on a vertical scale from 0 to 100, with ticks every 20 points. The legend identifies gray as No skill, ochre as Curated skill, and blue as SelfEvoSkill. The horizontal categories are SE, OWC, NS, IPS, FE, MOR, CS, MCP, and Avg. A dashed vertical line separates the eight domain categories from the overall average. Estimated bar values in legend order (No skill, Curated skill, SelfEvoSkill) are: SE 54, 40, 79; OWC 60, 60, 87; NS 41, 73, 83; IPS 21, 61, 71; FE 33, 44, 44; MOR 25, 36, 58; CS 41, 64, 67; MCP 34, 79, 83; Avg. 41, 57, 74. SelfEvoSkill is highest in seven domains and ties Curated skill at FE; it exceeds No skill in every domain. The overall average is highest for SelfEvoSkill, followed by Curated skill and No skill.
